title: Long-Distance Hammer
setup: Your rook on b2 is staring up an empty file, with the back rank wide open at the other end.
hint: Black's king has three of its own pawns in front of it. Find the rank it cannot leave.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is a pure back-rank mate. {{Rb8#}} runs the length of the b-file and checks along the eighth rank. f8 and h8 are on the rook's line, f7, g7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns, and nothing can capture the rook or block.

A rook far from the action can still mate in one. Before you move, scan every open file for your rooks and every open diagonal for your bishops.
